company.name: Cockroach Labs
company.shortDescription: Cockroach Labs is a software company that develops a cloud-native SQL database for modern cloud applications.
company.description: Cockroach Labs is behind Cockroach DB, the cloud-native, distributed SQL database to modern cloud applications. It helps companies of all sizes—and the apps they develop— to scale fast, survive anything, and thrive everywhere. CockroachDB is in use at some of the world's largest enterprises across all industries, including Equifax, Bose, Comcast, and some of the largest companies in banking, retail, and media.

aiResearchSummary.text: Cockroach Labs is researching methods and systems for non-blocking transactions, enabling efficient execution of write transactions in distributed databases, as described in 'Methods and systems for non-blocking transactions.' They are also developing systems for block properties in log-structured merge tree storage, optimizing data structure encoding and filtering. Additional work includes locality-aware query optimization and multi-region database systems, highlighting focus areas in distributed, cloud-native SQL database technology.
